               Search: "Broadcom financial news latest week"

            - Source: [URL and date]

            2. [Headline] - [Date] - [Source] - [Impact: Positive/Negative/Neutral]

            - [Other available metrics]

attributes.result.structuredContent.results.0.title: Broadcom is joining Alphabet in the AI rally. Why investors are jumping in - CNBC
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.0.conte: * The move in Broadcom comes as investors continue to push shares of Google-parent Alphabet higher. Broadcom shares rallied 10.3% on Monday, as investors poured back into several high-flying tech companies tied to the artificial intelligence trade. The move in Broadcom comes as investors continue to push shares of Google-parent Alphabet higher. The two are related through ASICs: Google is a major customer of Broadcom's ASIC business, as Broadcom helps design and manufacture Google's tensor processing units (TPUs). Jefferies analyst Blayne Curtis, who has the highest price target among analysts on Broadcom, per LSEG, named the stock a top pick earlier this month and said that ASICs are hitting an "inflection point" as Google's need for custom chips continues to grow.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.title: AVGO Stock To $700 Amid Google Partnership? - Forbes
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.conte: Broadcom's stock (NASDAQ: AVGO) just jumped 11% on November 24, fueled by enthusiasm surrounding its Google AI chip partnership and the successful launch of Alphabet's new Gemini 3 model. The stock is currently trading at over 60 times its trailing earnings — a high multiple that reflects Broadcom's premier positioning. Consider that Broadcom already has four confirmed hyperscale customers, including Google and Meta, for custom AI chips. If AI chip demand were the sole engine driving Broadcom, any slowdown would severely impact the stock. If Broadcom successfully executes on AI — acquiring more customers, increasing Tomahawk Ultra production, and sustaining its inference edge — while concurrently enhancing VMware’s recurring revenue, the pathway to $700+ over the next few years appears plausible.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.title: Nvidia shares hit by report on new AI chip competition. How worried should investors be? - CNBC
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.conte: Markets Markets Analysts aren't taking the news as an immediate hit to Nvidia, as the chipmaker is still the market leader with its GPUs. NVDA AVGO 1Y mountain Nvidia and Broadcom stock performances over the past year. Right now the real question should really be 'is the opportunity in front of us still big, or is it not?' as (hopefully!) we are not yet in a mature, saturated market for AI hardware. "We continue to see AVGO and NVDA as the 2 key players in the AI space." Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya is also bullish on both Nvidia and Broadcom as well. Here are Tuesday's biggest analyst calls: Nvidia, Apple, Tesla, Microsoft, Oracle, Live Nation, Coinbase & more
